music.prompt: Dark, elegant minimal score: a slow pulse of low cello and soft synth bass at 60 bpm, a glassy celesta motif that circles the same four notes again and again like a loop you cannot leave, faint shimmering metallic textures; restrained, hypnotic, a little seductive, gradually tighter and more insistent, no drums, no vocals

The loop stops; a single sustained low string note and a quiet bowed-vibraphone tone ring out, then a slow, tender solo piano plays a few searching chords in a minor key, intimate and honest, lots of space, ending on one unresolved but hopeful warm chord that hangs in the air

sfx.prompt: Large studio spotlight switching on, heavy electrical clunk followed by a low hum
Molten metal shifting and bubbling, short liquid gold slosh with a soft hiss
A handful of gold coins clinking and settling on a stack
Molten metal reforming, deep liquid swirl ending in a bright metallic ring
Distant crowd applause in a large hall, swelling then fading out
Liquid metal settling into a solid shape, then a soft crystalline shimmer like glass being polished
A single soft high glass harmonic tone, pure and warm, slowly fading
